visual.general_description: Grayscale axial cross-sectional image of the head with bright bone, black air spaces and gray soft tissue.
visual.detailed_description: Single unlabeled axial grayscale image on a black background with a dark band along the top edge. The nasal cavity and paranasal air spaces appear black at the top, with thin white bone walls. Bright white bone outlines the skull base and mastoid regions on both sides; the mastoid regions show a honeycomb pattern of small dark air cells separated by bright septa. The two sides of the image differ: on the image left, a large rounded mid-gray region lies beside the central bright bone, while on the image right a small bright oval and a black elongated channel are seen near the ear outline. A large mid-gray region fills the centre and lower half, bordered by bright bone. Both external ears are visible as curved soft-tissue outlines. No text, side markers, arrows, measurement bars, scale or patient information are visible.

visual.general_description: Axial grayscale cross-section of the lower head and upper neck with yellow letters, a series text overlay and a scale bar.
visual.detailed_description: Single axial grayscale image on a black background. Printed text at top left in light blue reads "Se: 11 Im: 28/50"; yellow letters are printed at the top ("A" followed by blurred characters), left ("RFP"), right ("LHA") and bottom ("PFL"). A vertical bracket on the right edge carries the number 5 above the label "cm". Dark air-filled spaces lie in the upper centre, surrounded by bright and mid-gray tissue; a round structure with a dark outline and a speckled mid-gray interior lies centrally in the lower half, flanked by darker gray regions. Bright irregular signal is present in soft tissues on both sides, more extensive on the image left. The appearance is blurred and low resolution.
